mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_HYDRA (49), drawn as MONSTER_MODEL_HYDRA = 37 (_enum.h:4187), so OpenMonsterModel loads Monster38.bmd. OpenMU Version075 Maps/Atlans.cs:533-563 names breed 49 'Hydra'. docs/atlans-port.md Part B 4.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13786-13792, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_HYDRA: OpenMonsterModel(MONSTER_MODEL_HYDRA); CreateCharacter(Key, MODEL_HYDRA, ...); Scale = 1.0f; BlendMesh = 5 at BlendMeshLight 0. No weapon. Its horn, bone 63 (Cone01), carries a lightning and a shiny sprite always (:11216-11219) and lets its BITMAP_BOSS_LASER go every fifth attack frame (:1905-1913).
rig_from: Seven actions, exported with --actions=all. 77 bones. MONSTER_MODEL_HYDRA plays both attacks at 0.15 and its death at 0.2 (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3671-3677). Mesh 6 (bbbb) is MU's empty texture holder, one vertex; here it carries mesh 0's 664 vertices and bones again, for the overlay below.
sheet_from: Seven sheets out of Data/Monster beside the model, decoded under a hydra_ prefix: bbbb00.OZJ (256, the body, 909 triangles) -- near-black scaled hide with grey plates and a ribcage of red-lit teeth; bbb01.OZT (128, 28) -- grey-brown membranes, its alpha a real mask; bbb02.OZT (32x64, 12) -- gold claws, masked; bbbb02.OZJ (32, 16) -- a cyan water swirl; uo00.OZJ (64x128, 1088) -- the necks and heads, grey-brown scales with a fiery band; bbbb03.OZJ (16, 32) -- a red bar; bbbb.OZJ (256) -- red veins and green glands on black, which no mesh wears in the file (uo01.OZT is loaded by nothing).
sheet_materials_from: The hide and the necks skin, matte as MU's flat-lit body reads: chitin made the heads silver and glossy (the user, 2026-10-04, with screenshots of MU's: tan scaled necks, grey-violet heads); the membranes leather, blended as the Bahamut's fins; the claws bone. The three glows below are added and unlit, so their material only names them.
glow_from: bbbb03 is BlendMesh 5 (MU compares the mesh's texture index, ZzzBMD.cpp:1509-1516): added, at BlendMeshLight 0 when it is made and up 0.1 a frame while it attacks, clamped at 1 and never lowered again (MoveCharacterVisual, ZzzCharacter.cpp:5989-5995) -- so from its first swing on, a steady red glow; ours, never drawn (play_open.cpp, Drawn::beamMaterial): each of its four heads throws the Lizard King's red lightning instead, one bolt a part of its split blow (the user, 2026-10-04: 'from heads we shoot red lightiing not lasers?'); kept in the model, at 0.4, so the beams can come back. bbbb and bbbb02 are RenderCharacter's second pass over a Hydra (ZzzObject.cpp:2635-2641): mesh 0 again under bbbb.jpg and mesh 3 under RENDER_CHROME | RENDER_BRIGHT with its v scrolling, both at sin(WorldTime*0.002)*0.3 + 0.5 -- its veins breathing red over the hide. Ours: bbbb as a glow on its copy of mesh 0 (rig_from), and mesh 3 drawn as that glow in place of MU's solid draw plus chrome; at the renderer's slow pulse, WorldTime*0.001, half MU's breath,. The veins at MU's own 0.5 +- 0.3: the user's screenshots show the round face maroon with bright red veins, and at half it read black. The gem (bbbb02) at 0.7 +- 0.2 (at 1.2 it burned white, not cyan), standing for MU's RENDER_CHROME | RENDER_BRIGHT second pass: in MU's pictures a big cyan jewel glowing in the middle of the face.
soft_alpha_from: bbb01.OZT and bbb02.OZT are drawn by MU tested and blended (EnableAlphaTest, ZzzOpenglUtil.cpp:366-393), as the Bahamut's fins: the membranes seen through, the claws' edges soft.
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3671-3677: SetMonsterSound(..., 141, 141, 142, 142, 141), offsets from SOUND_MONSTER_BULL1 = 210 -- 351 HYDRA1 (mHydra1.wav) to move and die, 352 HYDRAATTACK1 (mHydraAttack1.wav) to attack and flinch. Wired as hydra_* in sounds.json.
islands_from: 177 islands for 2994 triangles, read by sheet out of the low blend: the necks and heads (uo00, 1088), the hide's own (bbbb00, 272), the red glow (bbbb03, 32) and the overlay's copy of the hide (bbbb, 909) are skin; 19 triangles of membrane alone (bbb01) are leather and blended; one island of 646 joins the hide to 9 membrane triangles and takes the hide's skin, so those 9 are cut rather than blended; the claws with the cyan swirl (bbb02 and bbbb02, 28) are bone. They arrived as skin.
